scientific_findings: INSERTION_DENOISING_BREAKTHROUGH: Latent score-matching diffusion set an all-time record for standalone insertion precision at 54.55% with gap ECE at 0.0036, proving that diffusion successfully denoises inter-phoneme epenthesis.

SUBSTITUTION_OVER_DENOISING: Conditioned score matching on the canonical prompt stream pulls slight phonetic substitutions toward canonical targets, blunting substitution precision. DSCA-Net (EXP-55) remains the superior standalone substitution classifier.
